title: Magnetic-field response of generalized Wigner crystals in twisted MoTe$_2$
summary: We report a magnetotransport study of fractional hole-filling states in the layer-polarized regime of a twisted MoTe$_2$ homobilayer. A perpendicular magnetic field suppresses the resistance peak at the two-thirds filling while enhancing the one-third peak by several orders of magnitude. Both remain near their commensurate densities. We argue that these commensurate states are generalized Wigner crystals whose distinct charge configurations define different magnetic lattices, leading to contrasting responses to spin polarization. Near half filling, we observe a qualitatively different state whose resistance maximum shifts approximately quadratically with field and exhibits pronounced transport anisotropy consistent with a stripe phase. These results reveal a strong dependence of magnetotransport on fractional filling and open a route to magnetic control of transport in moiré charge-ordered states.

AI.tldr: 研究了扭转MoTe₂同质双层中分数空穴填充态的磁输运，发现1/3填充峰随磁场增强数个量级而2/3填充峰被抑制，半填充附近出现条纹相。
AI.motivation: 探索摩尔超晶格中分数填充的广义Wigner晶体在磁场下的独特电荷构型与磁响应，理解磁输运对分数填充的依赖。
AI.method: 对层极化区扭转MoTe₂同质双层进行磁输运测量，施加垂直磁场，考察1/3、2/3及半填充处电阻峰随磁场的变化。
AI.result: 垂直磁场抑制2/3填充电阻峰，却将1/3峰增强数个量级，两者均保持近公度密度；半填充处电阻极大值随磁场近二次方移动，并表现明显各向异性，符合条纹相。
AI.conclusion: 磁输运强烈依赖分数填充：不同填充对应不同磁性格子构型，对自旋极化响应相反；半填充呈现条纹相，开辟了摩尔电荷有序态的磁调控输运途径。

title: Uniform instanton theory for bridge-mediated nonadiabatic tunneling
summary: Instanton theory provides a semiclassical approximation to nonadiabatic rate constants within a path-integral framework and captures nuclear quantum effects such as tunneling and zero-point energy. Although the simplest reactions proceed directly from reactants to products, a number of important nonadiabatic processes involve three electronic states and react via a concerted mechanism through a virtual bridge state, also referred to as bridge-mediated tunneling or superexchange. In previous work, we have derived an instanton theory to describe such reactions using a dominant tunneling trajectory that propagates on each of the three potential energy surfaces. However, this approach is only valid when the bridge state is sufficiently low in energy. In contrast, in the high-bridge regime, the trajectories on the bridge surface become infinitesimally short, which causes the previous theory to break down. In this work, we derive the appropriate asymptotic approximation for the high-bridge regime and find that the resulting theory reduces to a two-state golden-rule instanton with an effective coupling that describes a nonresonant hop to the virtual bridge state. We further develop a uniform asymptotic instanton theory that eliminates divergences and smoothly connects the high- and low-bridge regimes. In a companion paper, we apply the method to study the quintet-to-singlet transition (via a triplet bridge) of an iron(II) complex.

AI.tldr: 本文将半经典instanton理论扩展到三电子态非绝热反应的高桥态（high-bridge）极限，推导出渐近近似与统一渐近instanton理论，实现对高、低桥态区间的平滑衔接。
AI.motivation: 现有instanton理论能描述三电子态经虚拟桥态的协同隧穿（超交换）反应，但仅在桥态能量足够低时有效；高桥态区间中桥面上轨迹长度趋近于零，导致原理论失效，需要新的渐近处理。
AI.method: 对高桥态区间推导合适的渐近近似，将其化为带有效耦合的两态golden-rule instanton（描述到虚拟桥态的非共振跳跃）；进一步构建统一渐近instanton理论以消除发散并连接高、低桥态区间。
AI.result: 高桥态渐近理论约化为带有效耦合的两态golden-rule instanton；统一渐近理论消除了原理论的发散，并平滑连接高、低桥态两种极限。方法应用于铁(II)配合物经三重态桥的五重态-单重态跃迁（见姊妹篇）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为三电子态非绝热速率常数的半经典计算提供了覆盖高、低桥态区间的统一框架，扩展了instanton理论的适用范围。

title: Consistent perturbation expansions in screened interactions
summary: Many-body perturbation theory is a powerful framework to calculate spectroscopic quantities, as well as the total energy. However, the field suffers from the fact that different flavors of approximations lead to a wide range of results. We present several in principle exact expansions and discuss how to use them consistently. We concentrate on the first two orders in the respective screened Coulomb interaction. Of special interest is a consistent expansion around the Kohn-Sham system. We illustrate the performance of the various choices using the symmetric Hubbard dimer over a wide range of correlation strength. In particular, the expansion based on exact Kohn-Sham ingredients stands out as a promising route towards good energies and good spectra.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多种原则上精确的多体微扰展开，并讨论如何一致地使用它们，重点围绕Kohn-Sham体系的一致展开，用对称Hubbard二聚体验证其性能。
AI.motivation: 多体微扰论能计算光谱量和总能量，但不同近似方案导致结果差异很大，缺乏一致性。
AI.method: 给出若干原则上精确的展开，讨论其一致使用方式，聚焦于各自屏蔽库仑相互作用的前两阶，特别是围绕Kohn-Sham体系的一致展开。
AI.result: 在对称Hubbard二聚体上、在广泛关联强度范围内测试了各方案的表现；基于精确Kohn-Sham成分的展开在能量和光谱上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 基于精确Kohn-Sham成分的展开是通向良好能量与良好光谱的一条有前景的途径。

title: Layer-Asymmetry-Induced Topological Superconductivity in High-T$_c$ Bilayer Nickelates
summary: The recent discovery of high-T$_c$ superconductivity in bilayer nickelates has highlighted the crucial role of interlayer coupling and motivated proposals for dominant interlayer pairing. Whether such pairing can support topological superconductivity, however, remains unexplored. Here, we demonstrate that substrate-supported bilayer nickelate thin films can host an intrinsic time-reversal-invariant topological superconducting phase protected by diagonal mirror symmetry. Using a two-orbital model derived from first-principles calculations, we show that a modest layer-asymmetric potential and layer-staggered Rashba spin-orbit coupling drive the system into this topological phase over a broad parameter range with a dominant interlayer pairing. The nontrivial topology arises from a reversal of the pairing sign on one of the spin-split bonding Fermi surfaces and is characterized by a nonzero mirror winding number along the diagonal direction, as well as a Majorana Kramers pair at the [11] edge. The phase also features bulk gap nodes located slightly away from the diagonal directions, featuring chiral charge and zero-energy flat bands. We discuss experimental routes for realizing and tuning this phase. Our results establish high-T$_c$ bilayer nickelates as a promising platform for topological superconductivity, where tunable topological transitions and Majorana boundary modes can provide probes of unconventional pairing.

AI.tldr: 本文预言衬底支撑的双层镍酸盐薄膜可在对角镜像对称保护下实现本征时间反演不变的拓扑超导相，并给出实验调控路径。
AI.motivation: 双层镍酸盐高温超导的发现凸显了层间耦合的重要性，并启发了层间配对占主导的设想；但这类配对能否支持拓扑超导此前尚未被探索。
AI.method: 基于第一性原理得到的两轨道模型，研究层不对称势与层交错Rashba自旋轨道耦合在以层间配对为主的体系中的作用，计算镜像缠绕数与边界态。
AI.result: 在较宽参数范围内，适度的层不对称势与层交错Rashba耦合可驱动体系进入拓扑超导相；拓扑性源于某自旋劈裂成键费米面上配对符号反转，表现为沿对角方向非零镜像缠绕数和[11]边界上的马约拉纳Kramers对；体态在对角方向附近存在能隙节点，伴随手性电荷与零能平带。
AI.conclusion: 双层镍酸盐高温超导是拓扑超导的潜在平台，可调拓扑相变与马约拉纳边界模可探测非常规配对；文中还讨论了实现与调控该相的实验途径。

title: Emergent Noncoplanar Spin Chirality through Magnetic and Nonmagnetic Substitution in the Kagome Antiferromagnet Mn$_3$Sn
comment: Accepted for publication in Materials Today Physics, 35 pages, 8 figures
summary: Controlling noncoplanar spin textures in centrosymmetric magnets remains a central challenge for realizing emergent Berry-phase phenomena. Here, we demonstrate that magnetic (Cr) and nonmagnetic (Cu) substitution at the Mn site provide distinct routes to engineer spin chirality and topological transport in the kagome antiferromagnet Mn$_3$Sn. Cr substitution enhances low-temperature spin canting, stabilizing a dense noncoplanar texture that yields a pronounced topological Hall effect (THE) at low temperatures. In contrast, Cu substitution drives a spin-reorientation transition accompanied by an easy-axis rotation, creating a broad temperature window (150--208 K) where competing magnetic anisotropies stabilize noncoplanar spin textures and generate a large THE. A concurrent carrier-type crossover signals an underlying electronic-structure reconstruction. These results reveal that exchange enhancement and exchange dilution represent two fundamentally different pathways for tuning real-space Berry curvature, establishing chemical substitution as a powerful strategy for engineering topological transport in kagome antiferromagnets.

AI.tldr: 在kagome反铁磁体Mn₃Sn中，Cr替代增强低温自旋倾斜形成致密非共面结构，Cu替代驱动自旋重取向并产生宽阔温度窗口内的非共面织构，二者分别通过交换增强与交换稀释调控实空间Berry曲率与拓扑霍尔效应。
AI.motivation: 中心对称磁体中非共面自旋织构的调控一直是实现涌现Berry相位现象的核心难题，需要找到有效的工程手段来操控自旋手性与拓扑输运。
AI.method: 在kagome反铁磁体Mn₃Sn的Mn位分别进行磁性Cr与非磁性Cu替代，通过化学替代对比研究两者对自旋织构、磁各向异性及输运性质的影响，并观测拓扑霍尔效应与载流子类型变化。
AI.result: Cr替代增强低温自旋倾斜，在低温产生显著拓扑霍尔效应；Cu替代驱动伴随易轴旋转的自旋重取向，在150–208 K形成宽温度窗口下的非共面织构并产生大拓扑霍尔效应，同时出现载流子类型交叉，指示电子结构重构。
AI.conclusion: 交换增强与交换稀释是调控实空间Berry曲率的两种根本不同路径，化学替代是工程kagome反铁磁体中拓扑输运的有力策略。

title: Quantum materials QED with van der Waals crystals
comment: 29 pages, 4 main figures and 3 supplemental figures; includes Supplemental Material
summary: A central goal of the emerging field of materials QED is to harness subwavelength electromagnetic confinement in engineered cavities to tailor light-matter interactions. Here, we demonstrate that van der Waals multilayer cavities composed of stacked graphene and hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) provide unprecedented control over hybridization between their electromagnetic resonances. By magnetically tuning graphene inter-Landau-level transitions (ILTs) into resonance with hBN phonons, we witness broadband, mode-selective strong coupling in the mid-infrared. Our quantum-material QED framework shows that cavity geometry and layer placement jointly control both coupling strength and modal selectivity. For experimentally realistic cavity parameters, the predicted mode splitting exceeds the width of the hBN Reststrahlen band, providing a direct route to the ultrastrong coupling regime. Together, these results establish van der Waals multilayer cavities as a scalable platform for tunable multimode QED and broaden the design space for reconfigurable quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明由石墨烯与hBN堆叠构成的范德华多层腔可实现电磁共振杂化的前所未有的调控，通过磁场调节石墨烯ILT与hBN声子共振实现中红外宽带模式选择性强耦合，并预示超强耦合区间。
AI.motivation: 材料QED领域的核心目标是利用工程腔中的亚波长电磁约束来定制光-物质相互作用，作者希望探索新型可调谐腔平台以增强对杂化的控制。
AI.method: 采用石墨烯与六方氮化硼(hBN)堆叠的范德华多层腔，通过磁场将石墨烯的层间朗道能级跃迁(ILT)调谐至与hBN声子共振，建立量子材料QED框架分析腔几何与层位置对耦合强度和模式选择性的影响。
AI.result: 观察到中红外波段的宽带、模式选择性强耦合；腔几何与层位置共同调控耦合强度与模态选择性；在实验可行参数下预测的模式劈裂超过hBN Reststrahlen带宽度，指向超强耦合区间。
AI.conclusion: 范德华多层腔为可调多模QED提供了可扩展平台，并拓宽了可重构量子材料的设计空间。

title: CIS(2): a state-specific, size-intensive perturbative correction to configuration interaction singles
summary: We present a state-specific second-order perturbation theory based on a configuration interaction singles (CIS) reference and its generalized Fock operator. Starting from a fully internally contracted construction, we retain the complete doubles space and internally contracted triples in the first-order wave function. We consider two partitions, Canonical and Block-diagonal, with reference excitation energies given by the Fock excitation gap $ω^{(0)}$ and the CIS excitation energy $ω_{\rm CIS}$, respectively. Our analysis establishes that strict size-intensivity is preserved when the contracted-triples denominators use bare Fock gaps and the occupied--virtual Fock block is projected to remove residual spectator coupling. Based on this observation, combining Canonical triples with Block-diagonal doubles yields a size-intensive Hybrid partition. These properties are verified for water with non-interacting helium atoms. Our formulation enables $O(o^3v^2)$ cost per matrix--vector product in a semicanonical basis. On the QUEST\#1 benchmark, Canonical and Block-diagonal show opposite systematic biases, whereas Hybrid gives the best overall accuracy among the three partitions. Its mean absolute errors for singlets and triplets are 0.24 and 0.15~eV, compared with 0.28 and 0.22~eV for CIS(D). The improvement is largest for Rydberg excitations, although CIS(D) remains more accurate for valence singlets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于CIS参考态与广义Fock算符的态特定二阶微扰理论，通过引入Hybrid分区实现严格size-intensive，且成本为O(o³v²)。
AI.motivation: CIS(D)等现有方法在激发能计算上存在系统偏差，作者希望构建更精确且保持size-intensive性的态特定微扰理论。
AI.method: 从完全内部收缩构造出发，保留完整双激发空间和一阶波函数中的内部收缩三重激发；考虑Canonical和Block-diagonal两种分区，分别用Fock激发能隙ω⁽⁰⁾和CIS激发能ω_CIS作为参考值；发现收缩三重态分母用裸Fock能隙并投影占据-虚Fock块可保持严格size-intensitive，据此将Canonical三重态与Block-diagonal双激发组合为Hybrid分区。
AI.result: 在水分子加非相互作用氦原子上验证了size-intensitive性质；semicanonical基下每次矩阵-向量积成本为O(o³v²)；在QUEST#1基准上，Canonical与Block-diagonal呈相反系统偏差，Hybrid总体精度最佳，单重态和三重态MAE分别为0.24和0.15 eV（CIS(D)为0.28和0.22 eV），Rydberg激发改进最大，但价态单重态上CIS(D)仍更准。
AI.conclusion: Hybrid分区在保持严格size-intensitive的同时，在CIS(D)基线上显著提升激发能精度，尤其对Rydberg激发，但价态单重态仍待改进。

title: Decohering Kitaev's Sixteenfold Way: A Holographic Approach
summary: We study anyon decoherence in 2D topological order, with the fermion decoherence in Kitaev's sixteenfold way as explicit examples. The sixteenfold way includes chiral topological phases, which are believed to admit no commuting projector Hamiltonian, making it challenging to study their decoherence directly. We further conjecture the density matrix produced by this decoherence induced phase transition can be obtained by a three-step procedure: first lift the topological order to its Walker-Wang model, followed by a transition to another Walker-Wang model, and finally trace over the bulk degrees of freedom. This establishes a connection between the decoherence of a topological order and a pure state phase transition in its 3D counterpart. Many examples are given. In particular, we show that decohering the fermion in each of the sixteen states always yields an intrinsically mixed-state topological order, a consequence of the fact the corresponding 3D bulk always transits into the 3D fermionic toric code (fTC). Our result suggests a systematic method for studying anyon decoherence in chiral topological orders at the level of commuting projector Hamiltonians.

AI.tldr: 研究2D拓扑序中的任意子退相干，以Kitaev十六重态中的费米子退相干为例。由于手性拓扑相不含对易投影哈密顿量，直接研究困难。作者猜想退相干诱导相变的密度矩阵可通过三步获得：先将拓扑序提升为其Walker-Wang模型，再转变到另一Walker-Wang模型，最后对体自由度求迹。这建立了2D拓扑序退相干与3D对应物纯态相变的联系。
AI.motivation: 手性拓扑相被认为不存在对易投影哈密顿量，导致直接研究其退相干极具挑战。需要一种系统方法，在无需显式对易投影哈密顿量的情况下研究手性拓扑序中的任意子退相干。
AI.method: 以十六重态费米子退相干为显式例子；提出三步猜想构造退相干密度矩阵：(1) 将拓扑序提升为Walker-Wang模型；(2) 转变到另一个Walker-Wang模型；(3) 对体自由度求迹。并给出多个实例验证。
AI.result: 证明十六重态中每一个态对费米子退相干后总得到内禀混合态拓扑序，这是因为对应3D体总是转变到3D费米子环面码(fTC)。
AI.conclusion: 该结果揭示：2D拓扑序的退相干与其3D对应物的纯态相变存在联系，并提供了一种在对易投影哈密顿量层面系统研究手性拓扑序任意子退相干的方法。

title: Orientation refinement for nanobeam precession electron diffraction patterns using spot intensity profiles
summary: We develop a method to measure crystallographic orientations with high angular resolution for nano-beam precession electron diffraction patterns, and applicable to 4D scanning precession electron diffraction. We show that internal variations of intensity in the diffraction spots can be simulated and correlated to experimental variations to measure the crystallographic orientation with a much better angular resolution that with the standard method of automated crystal orientation mapping (ACOM). In a tilt series carried out with long exposure time on a monocrystal of silicon around the main goniometer tilt axis, the imposed tilt angles are retrieved with a 0.044° to 0.054° precision with refinement, against 0.25° to 0.33° with the standard method. Shorter exposure times, introducing Poisson noise, marginally degrade the precision to a 0.054° to 0.066° range. The method also corrects a systematic error of ACOM near zone axis.

AI.tldr: 提出一种对纳米束进动电子衍射(NPED)花样进行高角分辨率晶体取向测量的方法，可应用于4D扫描进动电子衍射。
AI.motivation: 传统自动晶体取向映射(ACOM)角分辨率有限，且在晶带轴附近存在系统误差，需要更高精度的取向测量方法。
AI.method: 利用衍射斑内部强度变化的模拟，与实验强度变化相关联，从NPED花样中反演晶体取向。
AI.result: 在单晶硅倾斜序列中，精修后倾斜角恢复精度达0.044°–0.054°，而标准方法仅为0.25°–0.33°；短曝光引入泊松噪声后精度略降至0.054°–0.066°；同时校正了ACOM在晶带轴附近的系统误差。
AI.conclusion: 该方法显著提升晶体取向测量的角分辨率，并修正ACOM的系统误差，适用于4D扫描进动电子衍射。

title: Extracting the anyon charge from shot noise in complex fractional quantum Hall edges
summary: Shot-noise measurements with a quantum point contact provide a direct probe of the quasiparticle charge in Laughlin fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states. However, the interpretation of such measurements becomes more subtle for multichannel edges, where the point-contact tunneling noise coexists with noise generated by intermode equilibration and heating. We develop a general framework that incorporates both these contributions and apply it to the paradigmatic $ν=2/3$ FQH edge. We derive expressions for the drain auto- and cross-correlations in a four-terminal QPC geometry and show that equilibration-induced heating affects the auto- and cross-correlations in parametrically different way than the intrinsic partition noise. This distinction permits us to propose a specific combination of the two correlations which strongly suppresses the heating contribution and fully recovers the tunneling quasiparticle charge. Our results thereby provide a systematic framework for interpreting shot-noise measurements in complex FQH edges and can be further extended to more general counterpropagating edge structures.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个包含隧穿噪声与模间平衡/加热噪声的通用理论框架，应用于ν=2/3分数量子霍尔边缘，通过组合自相关与互相关信号来抑制加热贡献并恢复准粒子电荷。
AI.motivation: 量子点接触散粒噪声测量可直接探测Laughlin分数量子霍尔态中的准粒子电荷，但在多通道边缘情形下，点接触隧穿噪声与模间平衡及加热产生的噪声共存，导致测量结果解释变得复杂，因此需要区分并处理这些噪声贡献。
AI.method: 作者发展了一个同时纳入隧穿噪声与平衡诱导加热贡献的通用框架，针对ν=2/3 FQH边缘，在四端QPC几何下推导漏极自相关与互相关的表达式，分析平衡加热与内禀分配噪声对两种相关性的参数依赖差异。
AI.result: 研究发现平衡诱导加热对自相关和互相关的影响在参数依赖上不同于内禀分配噪声，据此提出一种自相关与互相关的特定组合，该组合强烈抑制加热贡献并能完整恢复隧穿准粒子电荷。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为复杂FQH边缘的散粒噪声测量提供了系统性的解释框架，并可进一步推广到更一般的反向传播边缘结构。

title: Finite-momentum pairing and magnetic halos in a spin-imbalanced Holstein model
summary: Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) superconductivity, Cooper pairing at finite-momentum driven by spin imbalance, remains difficult to study numerically in two dimensions. The fermion sign problem in the spin-imbalanced attractive Hubbard model severely limits quantum Monte Carlo access to the low temperatures where pairing correlations are most pronounced. We show that the Holstein model, in which the effective attraction is retarded by phonon dynamics, strongly suppresses sign fluctuations under spin imbalance, enabling unbiased determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations deep in this regime. With increasing magnetization, zero-momentum pairing evolves into finite-momentum FFLO pairing, evidenced by oscillating real-space pair correlations and a shift of the pairing susceptibility peak to finite $\vec{Q}$. The finite-momentum susceptibility substantially exceeds its zero-momentum value. At high density $n \sim 0.875$, near magnetization $m \approx 1-n$ where the majority-spin density approaches half filling, FFLO pairing coexists with checkerboard charge-density-wave order at short range, while staggered longitudinal spin correlations emerge as a magnetic halo at larger distances. These spatial textures provide experimentally accessible signatures of finite-momentum pairing and motivate cold-atom realizations of FFLO physics.

AI.tldr: 该论文用Holstein模型规避符号问题，通过DQMC模拟在二维自旋不平衡体系中揭示了有限动量FFLO配对及其与CDW和自旋关联的共存。
AI.motivation: 二维FFLO超导（有限动量库珀配对）数值研究困难，自旋不平衡吸引Hubbard模型存在严重费米子符号问题，限制了量子蒙特卡洛在低温配对关联显著区域的应用。
AI.method: 采用Holstein模型（声子动力学导致延迟吸引）抑制自旋不平衡下的符号涨落，进行无偏行列式量子蒙特卡洛（DQMC）模拟。
AI.result: 随磁化增强，零动量配对演化为有限动量FFLO配对，表现为实空间配对关联振荡和配对磁化率峰移至有限Q；有限动量磁化率显著超过零动量值。高密度n≈0.875、磁化m≈1-n时，FFLO配对与棋盘电荷密度波短程共存，较大距离出现交错纵向自旋关联（磁性晕）。
AI.conclusion: 这些空间织构提供了有限动量配对的实验可观测特征，并推动冷原子实现FFLO物理。

title: Optimizing the magnetic hyperthermia efficiency from the structural dependence of dipolar interactions in magnetic nanoparticles assemblies
summary: Magnetic hyperthermia, based on the conversion of the magnetic energy of magnetic nanoparticles (MNP) under an alternating external field into heat, presents a great interest, especially because of important applications such as promising advances in cancer treatment. The underlying frequency-dependent response of the MNP assembly under the excitation field depends on the first hand on the individual properties of the MNP such as their size, shape and magnetocrystalline anisotropy and on the other hand on collective properties generated by interactions between MNP. Due to the long-range dipolar component of the latter, the first consequence is the so-called demagnetizing effects, making the response dependent on the external sample shape. This is the reason for studying the properties of MNP in assemblies of anisotropic external shapes such as films, chains, or elongated aggregates. In the present work, using a recently developed Time Quantified Monte Carlo (TQMC) framework for dynamic simulations, we focus more precisely on the importance of the local structure in such anisotropic aggregates to the dipolar interactions contribution of the response to the external field. Here the local structure is understood as both the location of the nanoparticles and the distribution of their easy axes. We show that the latter must be determined in a self-consistent way starting with the equilibrium structure of a ferrofluid modeled as the dipolar hard sphere fluid.

AI.tldr: 该工作用时间量化蒙特卡洛(TQMC)动态模拟方法，研究了各向异性磁性纳米颗粒(MNP)聚集体中局域结构（颗粒位置与易轴分布）对偶极相互作用及外场响应的贡献，并指出易轴分布需以偶极硬球流体平衡结构为基础自洽确定。
AI.motivation: 磁热疗依赖MNP在交变场下的磁能-热转换，其频率响应不仅取决于颗粒尺寸、形状和磁晶各向异性，还受颗粒间偶极相互作用影响。长程偶极作用导致退磁效应，使响应依赖样品外部形状，因此需研究薄膜、链、拉长聚集体等各向异性外形状中MNP的性质，尤其是局域结构对偶极相互作用贡献的重要性。
AI.method: 采用新近发展的时间量化蒙特卡洛(TQMC)框架进行动态模拟，聚焦各向异性聚集体中的局域结构；局域结构定义为纳米颗粒的位置及其易轴分布，其中易轴分布以铁磁流体（建模为偶极硬球流体）的平衡结构为起点，进行自洽确定。
AI.result: 研究表明，在各向异性聚集体中，局域结构（颗粒位置和易轴分布）对偶极相互作用给外场响应的贡献具有重要影响；易轴分布不能随意给定，必须通过偶极硬球流体平衡结构的自洽方式确定。
AI.conclusion: MNP聚集体的磁响应显著受局域结构和偶极相互作用调控，研究此类系统时应基于铁磁流体平衡结构自洽确定易轴分布，这对磁热疗等应用具有指导意义。

title: Topological insulators on complex networks
summary: The landscape of topological insulators has expanded beyond its traditional domain of periodic lattices with short-range hopping. Related studies have explored topological phenomena under non-Euclidean geometries, disordered structures, and long-range hopping, progressively narrowing the gap between topological phases of matter and complex networks. Here we demonstrate that genuine complex networks, far beyond periodic lattices and their conventional variants, can themselves host topological insulating phases. By developing a nonconflicting design framework for multiple topological objectives, we realize topological insulators in high-degree Hofstadter lattices and across regular, small-world, and random networks. This generalization uncovers distinct network-specific features, including an expanded range of attainable topological characteristics, a degree-dependent transition from Hofstadter-type to Haldane-type Chern insulators, and, most notably, the superior robustness and reconfigurability of small-world topological insulators. Our graph-theoretic framework establishes network complexity as a resource for realizing high-capacity and reconfigurable topological insulators.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向多重拓扑目标的非冲突设计框架，证明真实复杂网络（高次Hofstadter晶格、规则、小世界和随机网络）本身可承载拓扑绝缘相，并揭示了网络特有的拓扑转变与鲁棒、可重构特性。
AI.motivation: 传统拓扑绝缘体研究局限于周期晶格及短程跃迁，近期工作虽拓展至非欧几何、无序结构和长程跃迁，但真实复杂网络能否直接承载拓扑绝缘相仍未被充分探索，且网络复杂度是否可作为拓扑资源尚不明确。
AI.method: 作者发展了面向多重拓扑目标的非冲突设计框架，将该框架应用于高次Hofstadter晶格以及规则、小世界和随机网络，并采用图论方法分析其拓扑相与网络结构之间的关联。
AI.result: 实现了复杂网络中的拓扑绝缘体，发现了网络特有的新特征：可实现的拓扑特性范围更广；存在随节点度变化的从Hofstadter型到Haldane型Chern绝缘体的相变；小世界拓扑绝缘体表现出优异的鲁棒性和可重构性。
AI.conclusion: 该图论框架确立了网络复杂度作为实现高容量、可重构拓扑绝缘体的资源，将拓扑物态与复杂网络进一步融合。

title: Ab initio design of enhanced and sign-reversible spin Hall and spin Nernst conductivity in skutterudite materials
summary: The search for novel materials capable of robust spin-current generation remains an active area of research. Here, we investigate the intrinsic spin Hall and spin Nernst effects in Co- and Rh-based skutterudites and explore their enhancement through heavy-metal substitution and site-selective doping. Using first-principles calculations and Wannier-based tight-binding models, we analyze the spin Berry curvature and spin-transport responses of pristine MX$_3$, where M = Co, Rh and X = As, Sb, as well as chemically modified systems. Despite sizable momentum-resolved spin Berry curvature, the pristine compounds exhibit relatively small net spin Hall responses due to substantial cancellation across the Brillouin zone. Isoelectronic Ir and Bi substitution at 8$c$ Wycoff M site produces little enhancement near the E$_F$, whereas non-isoelectronic Pt substitution yields a relatively better response. Most interestingly, the incorporation of Pt at the interstitial $2a$ Wycoff site of RhAs$_3$ nearly doubles the spin Hall conductivity to $\sim400~(\hbar/e)(Ω,\mathrm{cm})^{-1}$ near the E$_F$ when compared to Pt substitution at 8$c$ position. At 300 K, the same interstitially filled system exhibits a spin Nernst conductivity of $\sim1.46~(\hbar/e),\mathrm{A,m^{-1}K^{-1}}$ at the E$_F$, nearly an order of magnitude larger than that of $M$-site Pt substitution. The enhanced responses arise from Pt $5d$ states, strong spin-orbit coupling, and avoided crossings that generate pronounced spin-Berry-curvature hot spots. These results demonstrate that site-selective chemical engineering can effectively overcome momentum-space cancellation resulting in enhanced spin Hall and spin Nernst responses in skutterudites. Our results provide a possible route towards robust spin-current generation in this class of materials.

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理与Wannier紧束缚模型研究Co/Rh基方钴矿的本征自旋霍尔/自旋能斯特效应，通过重金属替代与位点选择性掺杂增强响应，发现Pt填隙2a位可使RhAs₃自旋霍尔电导率近乎翻倍至~400 (ℏ/e)(Ω·cm)⁻¹，自旋能斯特电导率提升近一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 寻找能稳健产生自旋流的新材料是活跃研究方向，需探索方钴矿体系并克服动量空间自旋Berry曲率相消导致的弱净响应。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算与基于Wannier的紧束缚模型，分析MX₃(M=Co,Rh；X=As,Sb)及化学改性体系的自旋Berry曲率与自旋输运响应，比较8c位Ir/Bi/Pt等电子与非等电子替代及2a间隙Pt掺杂。
AI.result: 原始化合物因布里渊区相消净自旋霍尔响应小；8c位Ir、Bi替代增强甚微，Pt替代较优；RhAs₃中间隙2a位Pt使自旋霍尔电导率近翻倍至~400 (ℏ/e)(Ω·cm)⁻¹，300K自旋能斯特电导率达~1.46 (ℏ/e) A m⁻¹K⁻¹，比8c位Pt大近一个数量级，源于Pt 5d态、强自旋轨道耦合及避免交叉产生的自旋Berry曲率热点。
AI.conclusion: 位点选择性化学工程可有效克服动量空间相消，显著增强方钴矿的自旋霍尔与自旋能斯特响应，为稳健自旋流产生提供可能路径。

title: Evaluating Chern Topology in Discretized Brillouin Zones Using Bargmann Invariants
summary: We develop a finite-state geometric framework based on third-order Bargmann invariants for evaluating Chern numbers and characterizing local quantum-state geometry. Using gauge-invariant state overlaps, the framework evaluates the Chern number directly on discretized parameter spaces while retaining local geometric information through the phase-derived density and the complementary amplitude density, as well as signatures associated with changes in topological character. We apply the construction to the Qi--Wu--Zhang, $1/3$- and $1/4$-flux Hofstadter, SSH, and Rice--Mele models, including a rank-$2$ extension for isolated composite subspaces and applications to closed-loop and parameter-space topology. The resulting framework organizes Chern topology and local geometric information directly from finite-state data, providing a compact state-based description without relying on dynamical evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出基于三阶Bargmann不变量的有限态几何框架，用规范不变态重叠直接在离散参数空间计算陈数并刻画局部量子态几何。
AI.motivation: 需要一个不依赖动力学演化、可直接从有限态数据出发统一描述陈拓扑与局部几何信息的紧凑框架。
AI.method: 构建基于三阶Bargmann不变量的有限态几何构造；利用规范不变态重叠在离散参数空间直接求陈数；通过相位导出的密度与互补振幅密度保留局部几何信息；并给出用于孤立复合子空间的秩-2扩展。
AI.result: 在Qi–Wu–Zhang、1/3与1/4通量Hofstadter、SSH及Rice–Mele模型上验证，涵盖闭回路与参数空间拓扑，并能标识拓扑性质变化的特征。
AI.conclusion: 该框架从有限态数据直接组织陈拓扑与局部几何信息，提供无需依赖动力学演化的状态描述方式。

title: Coercivity-Aware Machine Learning Discovery of Rare-Earth-Free Soft Magnetic Alloys with First-Principles Magnetic Benchmarks
summary: Coercivity-aware machine learning is developed to screen rare-earth-free soft magnetic alloys using Curie temperature and coercivity as coupled design targets. A compiled experimental magnetic-material dataset is evaluated using composition-grouped partitioning to avoid overlap of identical compositions between training and testing, and elemental fractions and composition-weighted elemental descriptors are examined for prediction of the two magnetic properties. Residual-based prediction intervals and distance-to-training filters are then incorporated to screen Fe-Co-Ni-Mn-Al-Si compositions. Composition-grouped evaluation shows lower predictive accuracy than conventional random partitioning, demonstrating the importance of evaluating transfer to previously unseen compositions. Combining weighted elemental descriptors with elemental fractions improves Curie-temperature prediction, whereas the additional descriptors do not improve coercivity prediction, consistent with the strong dependence of coercivity on processing and microstructure. Uncertainty-aware screening substantially narrows the candidate space and identifies Fe-Co-rich compositions for further evaluation. First-principles calculations independently show strong magnetic polarization and magnetovolume effects in representative Fe-Co structures, while finite-temperature atomistic spin simulations place the Fe-Co benchmark systems on high magnetic-ordering-temperature scales. The combined approach provides a computational framework for prioritizing rare-earth-free soft-magnetic chemistries while distinguishing composition-level screening from candidate-specific physical validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种矫顽力感知的机器学习方法，用居里温度和矫顽力作为耦合设计目标筛选无稀土软磁合金，结合成分分组评估、不确定性筛选与第一性原理/自旋模拟验证。
AI.motivation: 无稀土软磁合金的筛选需要同时考虑居里温度与矫顽力两个耦合的磁性能目标，而传统随机划分评估可能因训练与测试集存在相同成分而高估模型迁移能力。
AI.method: 构建实验磁材料数据集，采用成分分组划分；对比元素分数与成分加权元素描述符；引入基于残差的预测区间与距训练集距离过滤器；筛选Fe-Co-Ni-Mn-Al-Si成分空间；并用第一性原理计算和有限温度原子自旋模拟验证代表性体系。
AI.result: 成分分组评估精度低于随机划分；加权元素描述符提高居里温度预测但未改善矫顽力预测；不确定性筛选显著缩小候选空间，识别出富Fe-Co成分；计算验证显示代表性Fe-Co结构具有强磁极化、磁体积效应及高磁有序温度。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为优先筛选无稀土软磁化学体系提供了计算框架，并区分了成分级筛选与候选体系的具体物理验证。

title: Plasmon modes in tilted three-dimensional nodal-ring semimetals. II. Vortex nodal ring
summary: We investigate collective charge excitations in three-dimensional vortex nodal-ring semimetals (VNRs), whose pseudospin texture winds around the nodal ring and differs qualitatively from that of the conventional $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric nodal-ring semimetal (PTNR). While plasmon modes in PTNRs have been studied in a companion work, arXiv:2609.35373. Here, we focus on how a VNR's pseudospin texture changes the response compared with the former. Within a low-energy two-band description and the random-phase approximation, we analyse the density response, density-of-states, Drude weights, dielectric function, and plasmon modes at low doping. We consider the untilted system together with in-plane and axial band-tilts. Although the VNR and PTNR have distinct Hamiltonians, pseudospin textures, and Berry-curvature distributions, their linearised energy dispersions coincide. The vortex texture, however, introduces a toroidal-angle dependence in the band-overlap factor and quantum metric, thereby modifying the charge response. We examine how these effects enter the dielectric screening and collective modes for different wavevector orientations. Our results clarify how pseudospin texture, beyond the band dispersion alone, influences collective charge dynamics in three-dimensional nodal-ring semimetals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究三维涡旋节点环半金属(VNR)的集体电荷激发，重点比较其与常规PT对称节点环半金属(PTNR)在赝自旋织构上的差异如何改变电荷响应。采用两带模型与RPA方法，分析了态密度、Drude权重、介电函数和等离激元模式，发现涡旋织构通过环向角依赖的带交叠因子和量子度量修正介电屏蔽与集体模式。
AI.motivation: VNR的赝自旋织构绕节点环缠绕，与PTNR定性不同，但两者线性色散相同；作者希望厘清在色散之外，赝自旋织构本身如何影响集体电荷动力学。
AI.method: 使用低能两带描述与随机相近似(RPA)，计算密度响应、态密度、Drude权重、介电函数及低掺杂下的等离激元模式；考虑无倾斜及面内、轴向带倾斜情形。
AI.result: VNR与PTNR哈密顿量、赝自旋织构和贝里曲率分布不同、线性色散却一致；涡旋织构引入环向角依赖的带交叠因子与量子度量，从而修正介电屏蔽和不同波矢方向下的集体模式。
AI.conclusion: 赝自旋织构（而非仅能带色散）是决定三维节点环半金属集体电荷动力学的关键因素。

title: Algebra of symmetry allowed physical properties of crystals
summary: The symmetry of a physical system given by the 122 magnetic point groups (MPGs) leads to only 21 sets of restrictions on any physical tensors. Those, so called, tenor forms were labeled by letters from A to U by R. R. Birss (Symmetry and Magnetism, North Holland, Amsterdam, 1964). A new concept of property-related point groups (PRPGs) is proposed. It is shown that the 21 PRPGs isomorphic to the 21 non-centrosymmetric crystallographic point groups (CPGs) corresponds to the 21 tensor forms. Therefore instead of a symbols from A to U one can use PRPGs as mathematical objects corresponding to the tenor forms. From the Neumann's principle given multipole component is only allowed in a system when a group describing symmetry of the system is a subgroup of the multipole component symmetry. Each tensor can be expressed in the terms of the multipole degrees of freedom, i.e. it corresponds to a subset of all multipole components allowed by given PRPG. Those relations leads to the algebra of tensor forms, where space of allowed tensor components and space of PRPG operators are somehow dual to each other.

AI.tldr: 提出"性质相关点群(PRPG)"概念，用21个与非中心对称晶体点群同构的PRPG替代Birss的A-U标记，对应21种张量形式，并建立张量形式代数。
AI.motivation: Birss用A-U字母标记21种张量形式，但这些字母是抽象符号，缺乏明确的数学对象对应；希望用更自然、可运算的数学对象来刻画张量形式。
AI.method: 引入PRPG概念：证明21个PRPG与21个非中心对称晶体点群(CPG)同构，对应21种张量形式；基于Neumann原理，将张量用多极自由度展开，特定多极分量仅当系统对称群是其子群时被允许，从而每个张量对应给定PRPG允许的多极分量子集。
AI.result: 用PRPG作为张量形式的数学对象替代A-U符号；建立张量形式代数，其中允许张量分量空间与PRPG算子空间彼此对偶。
AI.conclusion: PRPG为张量形式提供更本质的数学描述，并揭示张量分量空间与PRPG算子空间之间的对偶结构。

title: Beyond Pure Dephasing: Quantum Error Correction in Single Molecules Requires Multiple Spins
summary: We propose multi-spin molecules as a viable architecture for fault-tolerant quantum computing. To this aim, we introduce a correction protocol handling both diagonal and off-diagonal errors, typically associated with dephasing and relaxation. The scheme is based on a hybrid encoding which combines dephasing-tolerant units suppressing the leading pure dephasing error into a multi-spin molecule implementing a multi-qubit code for residual off-diagonal errors. Our proposal leverages peculiar properties of molecular spins, i.e. the strong hierarchy between different errors and the possibility to engineer multi-spin molecules at the synthetic level. Moreover, it addresses the important issue of the loss of coherences in anharmonic systems subject to off-diagonal errors, which hampers their correction at the single spin level. Thanks to the huge suppression of dephasing by the first-level code, we numerically demonstrate the potential performance of this strategy even with a limited number of spins per logical unit.

AI.tldr: 提出以多自旋分子作为容错量子计算架构，设计混合编码纠错方案同时处理退相干与弛豫误差。
AI.motivation: 分子自旋具有误差强层级性和合成可调性，但现有方案难以在单自旋层面纠正非对角误差，需针对分子特性设计纠错架构。
AI.method: 采用混合编码：以抗退相位单元压制主导的纯退相位误差，再将其嵌入多自旋分子实现多量子比特码，纠正残余非对角误差。协议同时处理对角与非对角误差。
AI.result: 数值模拟表明，借助第一层级编码对退相位的巨大压制，即使每个逻辑单元仅有有限自旋数，该策略也展现出良好性能潜力。
AI.conclusion: 多自旋分子是可行的容错量子计算平台，混合编码可有效应对分子自旋中的主要误差，并解决非简谐系统退相干难以纠正的问题。

title: Second-order Raman and anharmonic lattice dynamics in lead-halide perovskites
summary: We explore the microscopic origin of THz-driven lattice dynamics in methylammonium lead bromide CH$_3$NH$_3$PbBr$_3$ using two-dimensional THz Kerr-effect spectroscopy. The analysis of the experiment enables discrimination between competing nonlinear excitation mechanisms and reveals that the dominant pathway is phonon-mediated rather than purely photonic. In particular, we argue that the commonly observed 1.15~THz Raman-active $A_g$ mode is not excited directly by the THz electric field. Instead, it emerges through cubic anharmonic coupling to an infrared-active phonon at 0.68~THz. Furthermore, a satellite feature at 1.36~THz is identified as a two-phonon Raman response of the same infrared-active mode. The observation of strong quadratic coupling involving the infrared-active phonon suggests an unconventional form of electron-phonon dressing present in lead-halide perovskites.

AI.tldr: 利用二维THz克尔效应光谱揭示CH3NH3PbBr3中THz驱动晶格动力学的微观起源，表明主导激发路径为声子介导而非纯光子过程。
AI.motivation: 探究甲基铵铅溴钙钛矿中THz驱动晶格动力学的微观机制，并区分相互竞争的非线性激发路径。
AI.method: 二维THz克尔效应光谱（2D THz Kerr-effect spectroscopy）。
AI.result: 1.15 THz拉曼活性Ag模并非由THz电场直接激发，而是通过立方非谐耦合到0.68 THz红外活性声子产生；1.36 THz卫星峰被确认为同一红外活性声子的双声子拉曼响应。
AI.conclusion: 主导激发路径为声子介导；红外活性声子的强二次耦合暗示铅卤钙钛矿中存在非常规的电子-声子 dressing 形式。

title: Complete Magnetic Hierarchy in Bichromatically Driven Unconventional Magnets
summary: We establish a general framework for engineering unconventional magnetism using bichromatic driving. We identify a sharp hierarchy: for a bichromatic drive with a generic even commensurate frequency ratio, the leading continuum $q$-wave magnet generates components only up to order $q-2$, whereas lattice higher-gradient terms supply the missing $q-1$ and $q$ parities and complete the hierarchy through order $q$. We explicitly illustrate this new revised hierarchy on a $d$-wave altermagnet irradiated by a circularly-linearly polarized light, and show that the asymmetry of the driving field is transferred to the light-dressed electronic structure, producing momentum-asymmetric dispersions beyond the static and single-frequency limits. We further show that this band asymmetry is absent in the leading continuum expansion and originates from higher-gradient lattice terms that are converted by the bichromatic drive into odd-in-momentum contributions. Extending the analysis to higher-order unconventional magnets, we further obtain complete magnetic hierarchies for all $q$-parity unconventional magnets. Our results establish bichromatic Floquet driving as a general route for generating mixed-parity magnetic hierarchies and dynamically engineering unconventional magnetism.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了利用双色驱动工程化非常规磁性的通用框架，揭示了磁性的分层结构，并证明了双色Floquet驱动可生成混合宇称的磁性层级。
AI.motivation: 探索通过双色驱动动态工程化非常规磁性，突破静态和单频驱动的限制，构造完整的磁性宇称层级。
AI.method: 建立双色驱动的通用理论框架，分析一般偶公度频率比下的连续q波磁体与晶格高阶梯度项贡献；以圆-线偏振光辐照的d波交变磁体为实例验证。
AI.result: 发现双色驱动存在清晰的层级结构：连续q波磁体生成至q-2阶分量，晶格高阶梯度项补全q-1和q宇称；驱动场不对称性转移至光修饰电子结构，产生动量不对称色散；该带不对称性源于高阶梯度晶格项被双色驱动转换为奇动量贡献。
AI.conclusion: 双色Floquet驱动是生成混合宇称磁性层级和动态工程化非常规磁性的通用途径，并获得了所有q宇称非常规磁体的完整磁性层级。

title: Illuminating early ZrC oxidation using ensemble small-cell DFT with dynamic gas management
summary: During zirconium carbide oxidation, liberated carbon can remain beneath the oxide or escape as gas, complicating the interpretation of mass measurements. We adapt the small-cell ensemble method using sixteen 140 ps ab initio molecular dynamics trajectories at 873-1273 K under a sustained high oxygen flux with gas removal. The average rates of net mass gain and total carbon transfer into gas or retained chains follow Arrhenius trends. Above 973 K, gas evolution levels off while total carbon transfer increases. The fraction of transferred carbon retained in chains rises from 40 % at 973 K to 66 % at 1273 K. Fits after 40 ps suggest declining carbon transfer rates over time, although not in every trajectory. These results show that carbon partitioning during early oxidation depends on temperature, with increasing temperature above 973 K favouring chain formation over gasification.

AI.tldr: 通过小细胞系综AIMD模拟研究ZrC氧化早期碳的分配行为，发现温度升高（>973 K）使碳更倾向保留为链状结构而非气化。
AI.motivation: ZrC氧化时释放的碳可能留在氧化层下或以气体逸出，使得质量测量结果难以解释，需弄清碳的分配机制。
AI.method: 采用小细胞系综方法，在873-1273 K、持续高氧通量并移除气体条件下，运行16条140 ps的从头算分子动力学轨迹。
AI.result: 净质量增益与总碳转移速率符合Arrhenius趋势；973 K以上气体逸出趋于饱和而总碳转移继续增加；碳链保留比例由973 K的40%升至1273 K的66%；40 ps后拟合显示碳转移速率随时间下降（但非所有轨迹）。
AI.conclusion: 早期氧化中碳的分配依赖于温度，973 K以上温度升高更有利于碳链形成而非气化。

title: Electrostatic Doping of Moiré Superlattices Controls the Optical Fingerprint of a WSe_2 /Twisted Bilayer Graphene heterostructure
summary: We theoretically investigate the optical response of the WSe2 monolayer vertically stacked on twisted bilayer graphene (tBG) under electrostatic doping. In this heterostructure, the doped moiré superlattice of tBG generates a spatially modulated electrostatic potential that couples to the electron and hole constituents of the WSe2 exciton through the screened Coulomb interaction, thereby providing a microscopic mechanism for exciton coupling to the charge-density landscape of the moiré Fermi sea. Focusing on twist angles below the magic angle (1.1°), where electronic correlations are strongly enhanced, we demonstrate that electrostatic doping induces pronounced modifications of the excitonic absorption spectrum, including the emergence of multiple satellite resonances. We show that these spectral features originate from the interplay between the exciton center-of-mass and internal degrees of freedom, together with doping-induced hybridization between Rydberg exciton states of different orbital symmetry. The calculated spectra are in good agreement with previously reported experimental observations and theoretical predictions. Our results establish electrostatic doping in tBG as an effective means of engineering excitonic states in adjacent semiconducting monolayers and provide a pathway toward novel optical sensor devices.

AI.tldr: 本文理论研究了静电掺杂下堆叠在扭转双层石墨烯(tBG)上的WSe2单层的光学响应，揭示了tBG莫尔超晶格调制势对WSe2激子的影响机制。
AI.motivation: 探究tBG的莫尔费米海电荷密度景观如何通过屏蔽库仑相互作用与相邻WSe2单层中的激子耦合，为工程化激子态提供新途径。
AI.method: 理论建模，考虑tBG掺杂莫尔超晶格产生的空间调制静电势，通过屏蔽库仑相互作用耦合WSe2激子的电子-空穴组分；聚焦低于魔角(1.1°)的扭转角。
AI.result: 静电掺杂诱导激子吸收谱的显著改变，出现多个卫星共振；这些特征源于激子质心与内禀自由度的相互作用，以及掺杂诱导的不同轨道对称性里德堡激子态之间的杂化。结果与已有实验和理论吻合。
AI.conclusion: tBG中的静电掺杂是工程化相邻半导体单层激子态的有效手段，并为新型光学传感器件提供路径。

title: Floquet density response in laser-assisted fast-electron scattering from solids
summary: We extend the Bethe--Floquet formalism of Joachain and coworkers, originally developed for laser-assisted electron--atom collisions, to inelastic scattering of fast electrons from a many-body condensed-matter target in a time-periodic light field. At first order in the projectile--target interaction, the general Floquet--Fourier cross section separates into exact laser-dressed projectile kernels and a matrix-valued Floquet density response of the target. For spatially structured or translationally non-invariant systems, the latter is the bi-momentum Floquet structure factor; its momentum diagonal defines the Floquet generalization of the dynamic structure factor, constrained by Hermiticity, positivity, and sum rules. As a controlled realization of the general projectile kernel, an eikonal--Volkov approximation for slowly varying inhomogeneous fields yields a finite-momentum-resolution convolution of the target response. In the homogeneous-field dipole limit, the projectile kernel reduces to Bessel-function sidebands and the cross section takes the familiar Bethe--Floquet form. The Floquet density correlator separates exactly into the outer product of the pump-induced coherent mean density and connected fluctuations. In the straight-trajectory nonrecoil limit, the coherent, target-elastic sector defines the weak-coupling PINEM amplitude; repeated coherent insertions generate the PINEM Bessel ladder, with an explicit no-double-counting prescription for combining this channel with connected losses. As worked examples, we evaluate the connected, target-changing cross section analytically for a metal in the Drude and diffusive limits, recovering Bessel-weighted plasmon-loss and diffusive combs, and for a driven two-level model that exhibits off-diagonal Floquet coherences through Bessel-channel interference.

AI.tldr: 将Bethe--Floquet形式主义推广到周期性光场中快电子从多体凝聚态靶的非弹性散射，给出精确的激光缀饰弹丸核与Flpquet密度响应（含结构因子、求和规则、eikonal--Volkov近似、PINEM极限及金属与二能级模型算例）。
AI.motivation: 原Bethe--Floquet理论仅适用激光辅助电子-原子碰撞，缺乏对多体凝聚态靶在时周期光场下快电子非弹性散射的统一描述，特别是空间非均匀/平移非不变体系与含靶关联的响应。
AI.method: 在弹丸-靶相互作用一阶，将Floquet--Fourier截面分解为精确激光缀饰弹丸核与靶的矩阵值Floquet密度响应；对非平移不变体系用双动量Floquet结构因子描述；引入eikonal--Volkov近似处理缓变非均匀场；在均匀场偶极极限退化为Bessel边带；将Floquet密度关联分解为泵浦诱导相干平均密度外积与连通涨落；在直轨迹非反冲极限给出弱耦合PINEM振幅与Bessel阶梯及无重复计数方案。
AI.result: 解析计算了金属Drude与扩散极限下连通改变靶的截面，得到Bessel加权的等离激元损失梳与扩散梳；对驱动二能级模型展示了通过Bessel通道干涉出现的非对角Floquet相干。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了光场下快电子非弹性散射的统一Floquet框架，统一了几何/关联靶响应、PINEM与Bethe--Floquet极限，并为凝聚态泵浦-探测式电子能量损失谱提供可计算方案。

title: Recrystallization as a tool to characterize and control the properties of cold sprayed materials: case study on 316L steel
comment: Manuscript for a submission to JTST
summary: Owing to the unique buildup mechanisms, recrystallization in cold sprayed materials significantly differs from that in conventional counterparts. In this study, the relationship between deformation-induced microstructural heterogeneity, recrystallization behavior, and mechanical properties of cold sprayed materials was investigated using EBSD and nanoindentation. The 316L stainless steel was selected as a model material. The deposit was characterized in its as-sprayed condition and after annealing at temperatures between 900 and 1100 K. Thermomechanical estimates suggest that locally, temperature can rise over 1000 K and very high dislocation densities (up to 1017 m-2) form at particle boundaries during impact, providing a strong driving force for subsequent recrystallization. The EBSD observations confirmed the intense defect accumulation and grain fragmentation localized near the particle interfaces. Recrystallization initiated preferentially in these highly strained areas after annealing at 1000 K and progressed with increasing temperature and holding time, leading to complete recrystallization after 1 h at 1100 K. The recrystallized grain-size distribution was well described by a heavy-tailed log-normal distribution, which indicates extremely heterogeneous strain partitioning generated during particle impacts. Nanoindentation measurements showed that the high hardness of the cold sprayed deposit remained largely unchanged after annealing at 900 K but gradually decreased as recrystallization progressed. We further demonstrate that controlled post-spray recrystallization can serve as a powerful tool for characterizing deformation during deposition and for tailoring the microstructure and mechanical properties of cold-sprayed materials.

AI.tldr: 本文以316L不锈钢为模型材料，结合EBSD与纳米压痕研究了冷喷涂材料中变形诱导微观结构异质性、再结晶行为与力学性能的关系，证实喷涂后可控再结晶可用于表征沉积变形并调控微观结构与力学性能。
AI.motivation: 冷喷涂材料因独特的构建机制，其再结晶行为与传统材料显著不同，但变形诱导的微观结构异质性如何影响再结晶及力学性能尚不清晰，需要系统研究。
AI.method: 选用316L不锈钢冷喷涂沉积体，分别在喷涂态及900–1100 K退火后表征；采用EBSD观察缺陷累积与晶粒破碎，纳米压痕测硬度，并进行热力学估算以分析局部温升与位错密度。
AI.result: 冲击过程中颗粒界面局部温度可超1000 K、位错密度高达约10^17 m^-2；EBSD证实颗粒界面附近缺陷强烈累积与晶粒细化；再结晶在1000 K退火时于高应变区优先启动，1100 K保温1 h后完全再结晶；再结晶晶粒尺寸呈重尾对数正态分布，表明应变分配极不均匀；900 K退火后硬度基本不变，随再结晶进行逐渐下降。
AI.conclusion: 冷喷涂材料的再结晶强烈受颗粒界面附近高度局域化的应变与缺陷控制；喷涂后可控再结晶可作为表征沉积变形、定制微观结构与力学性能的有效手段。

title: Magnetic-Order-Driven Nonlinear Photocurrents in PT-Broken Antiferromagnetic MnS2 and Altermagnetic MnSe2
summary: Nonlinear photocurrent responses generally require inversion-symmetry breaking, but its origin can be magnetic rather than structural. In this study, we investigate the bulk photovoltaic effect in antiferromagnetic MnS2 and altermagnetic MnSe2, two pyrite-type semiconductors whose magnetic ordering breaks inversion symmetry P and its combination with time reversal PT, while the accompanying lattice distortion is minute. We calculate the shift current (SC) and injection current (IC) responses under linearly and circularly polarized light with and without spin-orbit coupling (SOC) and identify their symmetry-allowed tensor components using the corresponding magnetic and spin point groups, respectively. Linear SC and circular IC are symmetry-allowed in both MnS2 and MnSe2 irrespective of SOC, whereas linear IC and circular SC remain forbidden in MnS2 but become allowed in MnSe2 only when SOC is included. These results highlight the importance of SOC and the corresponding MPG analysis for a complete description of nonlinear charge photocurrents in magnetic materials. Beyond charge responses, MnSe2 supports linear shift and circular injection spin photocurrents in the nonrelativistic limit, whereas all spin-photocurrent responses are forbidden in MnS2. Our findings therefore establish inversion symmetry breaking induced by compensated magnetic order as a route to generating and controlling nonlinear photocurrents.

AI.tldr: 在反铁磁MnS₂与交变磁性MnSe₂中，由补偿磁序（而非晶格畸变）破缺反演对称性，可产生并调控非线性光电流。
AI.motivation: 非线性光电流通常需要反演对称性破缺，但其来源可能源于磁性而非结构。本文探究磁序导致的对称性破缺能否成为产生非线性光电流的途径。
AI.method: 以黄铁矿型半导体反铁磁MnS₂和交变磁性MnSe₂为对象，计算在线偏振/圆偏振光下的shift current与injection current响应，分别在含与不含自旋轨道耦合(SOC)情况下进行；利用磁点群与自旋点群确定对称性允许的张量分量。
AI.result: 两种材料在无论是否有SOC时，线性SC与圆偏振IC均被对称性允许；线性IC与圆偏振SC在MnS₂中始终被禁止，但在MnSe₂中仅当包含SOC时才被允许。此外，MnSe₂在非相对论极限下支持线性shift与圆偏振injection自旋光电流，而MnS₂中所有自旋光电流响应均被禁止。
AI.conclusion: 补偿磁序诱导的反演对称性破缺可作为产生与调控非线性光电流的途径，同时强调SOC与相应磁点群分析对完整描述磁性材料非线性电荷光电流的重要性。

title: Symmetry Engineering Enables Deterministic Ensemble Polarization Control in Hexagonal Boron Nitride
summary: Optical polarization is a key degree of freedom in quantum photonic and sensing technologies, enabling efficient light--matter coupling and directional emission. However, in defect ensemble-based quantum systems, orientational averaging across many defects suppresses optical anisotropy and eliminates a deterministic polarization axis. Here, symmetry engineering is introduced as a strategy to restore collective optical anisotropy in negatively charged boron vacancy (V_B^-) ensembles hosted in hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN). By imposing anisotropic in-plane tensile strain through lithographically defined nano-ridge arrays, in-plane symmetry is broken and the ensemble emission dipole is aligned with the ridge-defined strain symmetry axis. Polarization-resolved photoluminescence reveals that the polarization visibility scales with the magnitude of strain anisotropy, while the emission orientation rigidly follows the engineered symmetry axis across devices with varying strain direction. This deterministic alignment is independent of crystal orientation, establishing the optical foundation for polarization-defined ensemble spin readout and programmable photonic integration in two-dimensional quantum materials

AI.tldr: 通过纳米脊阵列施加各向异性面内拉伸应变，打破h-BN中V_B^-色心 ensemble 的面内对称性，恢复集体光学各向异性并实现确定性偶极取向。
AI.motivation: 光学偏振是量子光子与传感技术的关键自由度，但缺陷 ensemble 中多缺陷取向平均会抑制光学各向异性，丢失确定性偏振轴，限制了其在偏振相关量子器件中的应用。
AI.method: 提出对称性工程策略：利用光刻定义的纳米脊阵列对 h-BN 中的 V_B^- ensemble 施加各向异性面内拉伸应变，打破面内对称性，使 ensemble 发射偶极沿脊定义的应变对称轴排列；结合偏振分辨光致发光进行表征。
AI.result: 偏振可见度随应变各向异性强度增大而提升；发射取向严格跟随工程对称轴，且在不同应变方向的器件中保持一致，并与晶体取向无关。
AI.conclusion: 该确定性取向对齐为二维量子材料中偏振定义的 ensemble 自旋读出和可编程光子集成奠定了光学基础。
